newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firmer in London, lead by banks.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firmer in London, lead by banks.

text.p: Japanese stocks gained in London on Tuesday, lead by shares in banks and trust banks, dealers said.

"Banks are the feature today but we are not seeing any real volume," said a dealer at Japanese brokerage in London. "A few professionals (market-makers) in London are getting back in after recent weakness."
Shares in Tokai Bank rose 3.50 yen to 850.50 yen from their Tokyo close by 1401 GMT, while Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi rose five yen to 1,845 yen.
Dealers said the overall tone was firmer following a moderate rally in blue-chips in Tokyo.
The Nikkei 225 climbed 241.12 points, or 1.36 per cent, to close at 17,933.59 and the Nikkei/ISE 50 Index in London rose 16.73 points or 1.18 percent to 1,444.70 from its previous close.
